public_body: Board Of Registration In Medicine Data Repository Committee
overall: The AG found the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session under Purpose 7 on May 4, 2011, because it was fulfilling a statutory disclosure duty, not disciplining a physician. Complaint closed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee wrongly entered executive session under Purpose 7 instead of Purpose 1 to discuss a 53B report about his client, which required discipline-related protections.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Committee plays no role in imposing discipline on physicians and Purpose 7 is the appropriate vehicle for carrying out its statutory duties.
